services.value: Independent laboratory certification and quality testing for highway safety products and raw materials, including testing of pavement marking and polymeric/paint/coating materials. The site lists ASTM tests performed (e.g., salt fog, coefficient of friction, coefficient of friction, retroreflectance, skid resistance, and various coatings/adhesives/plastics-related methods) and also states it “manufacture[s] testing equipment for highway safety products.”
